name: unctad-digital-government
description: Official plugin marketplace for UNCTAD Digital Government Tools — eRegistrations platform, BPA service development, government procedure reform, and digital public services

plugins.name: bpa-mcp
plugins.description: Install the BPA MCP server and register eRegistrations instance profiles (Nigeria, Jamaica, Lesotho, El Salvador, Kenya, Cuba, Colombia, Gambia, Bhutan, Guatemala). Install this first — all other plugins depend on it.

plugins.name: ds-mcp
plugins.description: DS (Display System) MCP server — read-only admin/ops monitoring for application files, workflows, processes, documents, payments, and user search. Requires bpa-mcp plugin for authentication.

plugins.name: gdb-mcp
plugins.description: GDB (Generic Database Builder) MCP server — manage databases, schemas, and records. Create registers, define fields, populate data, publish, duplicate. Requires bpa-mcp plugin for authentication.

plugins.name: graylog-mcp
plugins.description: Graylog MCP server — search and monitor logs across eRegistrations instances with Elasticsearch syntax. Uses Graylog-native auth (NOT Keycloak). Requires bpa-mcp plugin for instance management.

plugins.name: translations-mcp
plugins.description: Translations MCP server — context-aware translation of BPA services (field labels, tooltips, DS system strings, form structure, grids) plus one-command recovery from missing Global Translation bootstrap (translation_global_status / translation_global_reload). Requires bpa-mcp plugin for authentication.

plugins.name: service-documentation
plugins.description: Generate citizen-facing HTML service manuals (single and batch) and export structured Excel documentation covering fields, determinants, roles, bots, costs, and document requirements.

plugins.name: keycloak-mcp
plugins.description: Keycloak Admin MCP server for eRegistrations IAM management — manage users, roles, realms, themes, tokens, and diagnostics across all eRegistrations Keycloak instances. Requires bpa-mcp plugin for authentication.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: DevOps and deployment skills for eRegistrations infrastructure — Docker Swarm migration, Bitbucket→GitHub Actions repo migration, mule3-* post-migration alignment (CI/CD + propagator wiring), eRegistrations platform-version instance upgrades (orchestrator + per-env/per-version-pair sub-skills), configuration management, and deployment automation.

plugins.name: deploy
plugins.description: Self-service deployment requests on the singlewindow Coolify server. Invoke from the repo you want to deploy; the skill opens a well-formed issue on unctad-ai/deploy and GitHub Actions handles onboarding. Commands: /request-deploy.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Session handoff — capture state so any AI agent can continue your work. Auto-detects git state, plans, and environment context. Commands: /handoff:create, /handoff:quick, /handoff:resume.

plugins.name: share-service
plugins.description: Publish HTML or Markdown documents to share.eregistrations.dev and get shareable URLs. Commands: /share <file>, /share list.

plugins.name: terminal-stats
plugins.description: Rich terminal statusline with gradient context bar, dual 5h/7d thermal usage gauges, git info, cache hit rate, idle timer, and cost tracking. 3-panel display (SYS/CTX/OPS). macOS and Linux.

plugins.name: service-design
plugins.description: Skills for designing and extending eRegistrations BPA services across the BPA-backend + MCP cross-repo boundary. Bundles bpa-add-history-endpoint (Hibernate Envers revision history for any @Audited resource — Bot, Cost, Notification, Classification, etc.; mirrors the message_history pattern shipped in MCP v1.33.0). Each skill encodes a working diff with rationalization counters captured from baseline subagent testing — including the mvn verify / Spotless trap that has cost real CI time on this codebase.

plugins.name: leaflets
plugins.description: Build brand-matched applicant leaflets (explainer pages) for any online or government service, with an optional named voice guide (user-chosen name, man/woman voice, and language). Includes two grounding skills (service-concept-brief for legal-form types, service-journey-brief for single services) that derive a traced content map by cross-reading the law and the live BPA service.

plugins.name: screens-first-design
plugins.description: Define a product's UX screen by screen: an invariant page schema decided first, then per screen one clickable mobile mockup + one spec fiche, parallel agents copying a bundled reference grammar (OKLch tokens, phone frame, bottom sheets, slide-to-confirm — plus a desktop grammar: app frame, sidebar navigation, master-detail, right panels; mobile first, desktop derives), preview verification before showing, a regenerable docs compendium + guided tour + team presentations, a same-day D-numbered decisions journal, and a pre-verbal design check on every screen. Method proven on a full product design (8 screens + tour + presentations in one day).

plugins.name: team-bus
plugins.description: Jira-centered collaboration for humans + Claude sessions: a 15-min watcher surfacing new ticket comments and PR status changes in your session, plus the team conventions (findings as ticket comments, epic as shared memory).

plugins.name: eregulations
plugins.description: One front door for eRegulations work — plain English (or /eregulations:ereg) routes development, deployment and bugfix requests, resolves instance and version context, and enforces safety gates before anything runs.
